title: Original MIMII: supervised cross-machine identity transfer with eight synchronized microphones
license: CC BY-SA 4.0; Harsh Purohit et al., Hitachi Ltd., 2019
member_sampling: For each type/ID/state, intersect WAV basenames present in all three SNR archives, rank ascending SHA256 of UTF8 'singularity-mimii-v1|type|ID|state|basename', break ties by basename, retain first 16. Retain all three SNR variants. Do not replace members based on outcomes. Abort if insufficient members or invalid signal.
split_unit: Entire machine identity within type, including every selected stem and noise mixture. 00+02 train, 04 select, 06 protected confirmation; no recording windows cross splits.
classifier: Separate fixed supervised nearest-reference classifier per machine type. Center and standardize descriptors using training IDs only, population std (ddof=0). Squared distance mean over descriptors then selected channels. Predict binary label of first nearest training row in deterministic manifest order. No fitting, threshold or feature tuning using selection or confirmation.
cost: One unit per retained microphone; 160000 scalar samples per retained microphone per ten-second recording. Equal-cost proxy; no hardware price or energy claim.
tie_break: Minimum channel count then integer bitmask with mic1 bit zero.

contracts.nominal: Pooled balanced accuracy AND every type balanced accuracy >= corresponding intact full-array selection value minus margin.
contracts.nuisance: nominal AND every type x SNR balanced accuracy >= corresponding intact full-array selection value minus margin.
contracts.robust: nuisance AND every type x SNR x binary-class recall >= corresponding intact full-array selection value minus margin.
contracts.erasure_1: robust holds for intact S AND every S with one selected channel removed, always using the intact full-array selection thresholds; empty survivor infeasible.
contracts.erasure_2: robust holds for intact S AND every survivor after at most two selected channel erasures, with same thresholds; empty survivor infeasible.

enumeration: Enumerate every nonempty mask 1..255; never assume monotonic accuracy when adding channels. Infeasible objectives are reported as such.
greedy: For each contract, begin empty. At each step add the channel minimizing summed positive rational threshold deficits over that contract's cells (and all required erasure survivors), then integer mask. Empty survivors contribute deficit one per cell. Stop at first feasible mask or all eight. Report infeasible if exhausted. Optimally pruned greedy enumerates every nonempty submask of the greedy terminal mask under the same contract, minimizing channel count then mask.
comparators: Exact, greedy and optimally pruned greedy for all five contracts; representative mic1 fixed in advance; each of eight singleton microphones; intact full array. Same-cardinality distributions and all-mask confirmation outcomes descriptive only.
protected_confirmation: Feature extraction may process confirmation WAVs without displaying outcomes; training and sensor selection must not consume them. Hash and save protocol freeze before any signals, then selection snapshot and lock before any confirmation predictions. Do not alter choices after confirmation. Commit frozen protocol through authorized GitHub controls for an external checkpoint before data acquisition.
confirmation_claim: Report exact paired score differences under same predeclared cells and margins; pass/fail is descriptive on this bounded panel. A pass is not population noninferiority. Per-type confirmation has one machine and 32 independent stem groups at most, each with three related mixtures. Do not count mixtures as independent machines or claim factory-noise session independence.

sensitivity.selection_equivalence: Group all masks by identical complete selection prediction traces. On confirmation report which classes split and their score ranges, plus all minimum-cost feasible alternatives. Equivalence is empirical output equivalence only.
sensitivity.bootstrap: 2000 paired, stratified-by-type-and-class stem-group resamples, seed 20261020. Carry all SNR mixtures of each stem together. Report 2.5/97.5 percentile differences for primary exact panels vs full. Conditional on the four fixed confirmation machines; no machine-population confidence claim.
sensitivity.absolute_floor: Report whether every type x SNR x class recall is at least 1/2, separately from relative full-array preservation. No reselection.

observability: Reuse singularity.robust_coverage on train+selection empirical class min/max descriptor boxes per type x SNR. A microphone separates that distinction if at least one coordinate interval is strictly disjoint. Compare minimum_robust_panel and exhaustive_robust_panel for requirements1/2/3. These conditional boxes are not calibrated physical uncertainty sets; overlap is failure of this sufficient certificate, not physical indistinguishability. This multicover model is separate from nonmonotone additive-classifier erasure enumeration.
limitations: Balanced case-control subset, not natural prevalence or exhaustive MIMII benchmark
Supervised identity transfer differs from the original normal-only per-ID anomaly-detection benchmark
Hidden factory-noise source identities and temporal recording-session boundaries are unavailable; shared noise across splits cannot be ruled out
Only one selection and one confirmation ID per type; recordings cannot substitute for independent machines
Binary labels do not establish individual fault subtype
No hardware acquisition, new placement, phase beamforming, power, latency or field-performance claim
Exact rational finite-table optimality begins after numerical feature extraction and floating point predictions; no proof assistant verification is claimed
Any negative transfer, ties with stronger baselines or infeasible robustness requirement must be retained
